guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 本課以分區供氧、回流與碳鹼度協調為主線，從氮物種與負荷基準、硝化理論需氧、硝化鹼度消耗、反硝化電子供體進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
guides.conceptEn: This course develops coordinating zonal aeration, recycle, carbon and alkalinity through ten connected units, beginning with species and nitrogen basis, nitrification oxygen balance, alkalinity demand, denitrification donor demand. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

evidence: 在離線工作台先選取「氮物種與負荷基準」的觀測點。校正流量與氨氮儀，保留採樣時段。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「硝化理論需氧」的觀測點。把氨氮轉化量與耗氧率作質量配對。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「硝化鹼度消耗」的觀測點。以滴定鹼度與氮物種變化交叉檢核。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「反硝化電子供體」的觀測點。獨立量測 NO3-N、NO2-N、可利用 COD，避免把總 COD 全算可用。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「鹼度回復」的觀測點。在相同採樣日把硝化耗量、反硝化回復與實測鹼度並列。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「內回流與攜氧」的觀測點。量回流支線流量、DO 與 NO3-N，避免只讀泵轉速。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「溶氧儀校正」的觀測點。用第三個參考點比較校正殘差與容許誤差。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「回流水混合」的觀測點。量兩股流量與成分，再在混合充分的位置採樣。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「分區有效接觸」的觀測點。把分區入口與出口示蹤時間畫成圖。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「季節情境與交接」的觀測點。由不同溫度的批次資料擬合後，以未參與擬合的資料檢驗。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
evidenceEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for species and nitrogen basis. Calibrate flow and ammonium instruments and retain the sampling interval. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for nitrification oxygen balance. Pair ammonium conversion with oxygen-uptake measurements. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for alkalinity demand. Cross-check titrated alkalinity against changing nitrogen species. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for denitrification donor demand. Measure NO3-N, NO2-N and available COD separately rather than treating all COD as usable. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for alkalinity recovery. Tabulate nitrification demand, denitrification recovery and measured alkalinity for the same day. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for internal recycle and oxygen carryover. Measure recycle flow, DO and nitrate instead of using pump speed alone. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for do-probe calibration. Compare a third reference point with calibration residual and required tolerance. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for recycle blending. Measure both flows and concentrations, then sample after adequate mixing. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for effective zonal contact. Plot tracer arrival at the compartment inlet and outlet. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for seasonal scenarios and handoff. Fit batch data across temperatures and validate on held-out observations. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
pitfalls: 分子量與氮質量混用造成倍數誤差。診斷與介入：把各流股氮物種分列，查核高氨回流是否漏算。
忽略異營耗氧使氧量不足。診斷與介入：分列有機與硝化需氧，用氮轉化量交叉核對。
只量 pH 而不量鹼度可能錯過緩衝耗竭。診斷與介入：以鹼度滴定及氮轉化量查緩衝收支，不只調整 pH 顯示值。
不可降解 COD 被誤算為可用碳源。診斷與介入：查可利用碳與攜入氧，先核對電子供體收支。
把理論全回復寫入收支掩蓋未完全反硝化。診斷與介入：將實際反硝化量和鹼度回復配對，保留進流緩衝項。
只看回流比，未追蹤回流 DO。診斷與介入：量支線流量及 DO，離線比較回流與攜氧折衷。
探頭污染被誤認為真實氧需求改變。診斷與介入：清潔並依方法校正感測器，以獨立檢查點驗證。
低流量高氨流股可能控制負荷尖峰。診斷與介入：核對兩股流量及同成分分析，避免以簡單平均混合。
死角占據空間卻不提供相同比反應機會。診斷與介入：查分隔牆與旁流，將有效容積重新列入區段模型。
夏季調校直接複製到冬季可能失敗。診斷與介入：改用符合溫度區間的實驗資料，重跑低溫情境。
pitfallsEn: Mixing molecular and N mass creates multiplicative errors. Diagnostic response: Separate nitrogen species for every stream and check for omitted ammonium-rich returns.
Ignoring heterotrophic demand understates oxygen needs. Diagnostic response: Separate carbonaceous/nitrification demand and cross-check N conversion.
pH alone can miss depletion of buffering capacity. Diagnostic response: Check buffering with alkalinity titration and N conversion, not just displayed pH.
Refractory COD is mistakenly counted as available donor. Diagnostic response: Check available carbon and oxygen carryover, then close the donor balance.
Assuming full recovery masks incomplete denitrification. Diagnostic response: Pair actual denitrification with recovered alkalinity and retain influent buffering.
Watching recycle ratio without recycle DO misses the penalty. Diagnostic response: Measure branch flow/DO and compare recycle/oxygen-carryover trade-offs offline.
Probe fouling is mistaken for changing oxygen demand. Diagnostic response: Clean/calibrate by the relevant method and verify using an independent point.
A small high-ammonium stream can dominate peak loading. Diagnostic response: Check both flows and same-species analyses rather than arithmetic averaging.
Dead zones occupy space without equivalent reaction opportunity. Diagnostic response: Check baffles and bypass streams and update the compartment effective volume.
Copying summer tuning to winter can fail. Diagnostic response: Use observations appropriate to the temperature range and replay cold conditions.

history.text: 本課以公開技術手冊建立方法背景；來源出版年代不代表此程序首次發明的年代。舊版文件僅提供原理與歷史脈絡，現場工作仍須確認當地現行規定與設備文件。
history.textEn: Public technical manuals establish the methodological background; publication dates do not identify the invention date. Older documents provide principles and historical context, while real work still requires current local requirements and equipment documentation.

courses.connection: 本課以分區供氧、回流與碳鹼度協調為主線，從氮物種與負荷基準、硝化理論需氧、硝化鹼度消耗、反硝化電子供體進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
courses.connectionEn: This course develops coordinating zonal aeration, recycle, carbon and alkalinity through ten connected units, beginning with species and nitrogen basis, nitrification oxygen balance, alkalinity demand, denitrification donor demand. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.
